name: Capital Appreciation Ltd. (Araxi Limited)
source: Audited group annual financial statements, Araxi Limited (formerly Capital Appreciation Limited), year ended 31 March 2026, group statement of financial position and group statement of cash flows
note: Printed in R thousands, stored here in absolute rand. Capital expenditure is the acquisition of property, plant and equipment and the capitalisation of intangible assets. Non-current assets and current assets and total assets tie exactly, as do non-current plus current liabilities and total liabilities, and total equity plus total liabilities equals total assets, in both years.
